'''Var Narek's father''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] who was cheated out of becoming the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Livien Magnus]] by [[Ellor Orgraal]]. This caused Var Narek's father hold resentment towards him because Ellor Orgraal let other people rank up, and so [[Var Narek]], his son, had limited opportunities in the Empire.<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />
